svg.title: Engine A: from the command line to output
svg.desc: The command line is parsed, the ignore-aware parallel walker visits the files, each file's first read decides its path (small file, stream reader, split file, long lines), and the output is batched per file.
svg.text: // ENGINE A: FROM THE COMMAND LINE TO OUTPUT

g.text: 64 KB and one byte. A NUL
Matches are batched per file and sent to the caller's sink while other threads keep searching; plain
piped output shares one 64 KB buffer, so the lines of many files leave in one write.
Ctrl-C, --max-results or a closed pipe cancels the walk between files. --sort gives path order.
